verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs show instances come with Lambda Stack preinstalled, a standard set of AI/ML drivers, tools and frameworks. A selectable GPU Base image is also documented, and the API supports alternative base images, so developers avoid building a CUDA/ML environment from scratch. However, nothing shows a catalog of workload templates such as vLLM or ComfyUI, and PyTorch is not named specifically. Missing for 10: named template catalog (PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI), documented list of available images, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: Lambda also preinstalls Lambda Stack, a standard set of AI/ML-related drivers, tools, and frameworks, on the instance
GPU Base: An image based on Ubuntu Server that includes a minimal set of key AI/ML tools and drivers.
the API allows you to use a different base image for your instance
